nurse.text: Hiya, love. Come in. Sit down. Mind the chipped mug.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Hand them over. We'll have them tip-top before you can say 'arr-ite'.
There you go, la. Right as rain. Well, better than rain.
The Ark's over there. Don't put your scouse in it. We've had that.

else.text: No worries, la. The tea's on.
